lines: The blue powder caught between your teeth—
I'm a little torn over whether I should touch it
There are truths better left unspoken
So don't go saying you'd have been better off not knowing
No matter what happens, I'll love you all the same
Through it all, I'll be right here
Too close to see, ignored and overlooked
You, walking off alone in the rain
I whisper inside my heart: don't go down that road
You, keeping up the pretense of not hearing
Riding the momentum, you dive straight into the cesspool
What is that even
I told you before it happened
So then what gives
Why wouldn't you listen to a word I said
What's with that face lol
I swore at the corner of a town in bloom
What was that smile back then
What were those tears back then
Now and then it's fine to charge ahead boldly
And sometimes it's fine to walk with care
The truth, you see, was long ago
Simply something you knew but pretended not to
Even the regrets carved so deep into you
Fade away inside the days that repeat and repeat
With a resolve wiped clean, held to your chest
You, proud and unashamed, dive into the cesspool again
What is that even
I told you before it happened
So then what gives
Why wouldn't you listen to a word I said
What's with that face lol
I swore at the corner of a town in bloom
What was that smile back then
What were those tears back then
God, help me—this is bad, so bad, so bad, so bad
Light my way forward—this is bad, so bad, so bad, so bad
Try closing your eyes, lend your heart's ear, with a gentle heart
Listen for the answer, don't make me sing it again
A blues of betrayal
That's what I call "what the hell lol"
... I told you, didn't I
So then what gives
Why wouldn't you listen
What is it, what is it, what is it
What was that smile back then
What were those tears back then
What is it
